name: Marcus
bio: Archetype: High Tier Skills, Ultimate Cycle. ⌽ Inflicts and maintains [Annotate] on one enemy, prioritizing the boss. Gains [Eureka] each time that enemy moves and at each turn start. ⌽ Consumes [Eureka] to rank-up own skills at the start of each turn. Repeats until insufficient [Eureka] or no avaliable skills for rank up. ⌽ Ult deals more damage to the [Annotate]d enemy. Additionally grants [Eureka] and an extra pre-cast S1 next turn for immediate rank up. ⌽ When teamed up with at least 3 Plant/Spirit/Intellect units, gains additional Moxie when using 2/3 star skills.
